title: Order in the Matter of IndoStar Credit Fund
description: SEBI enforcement order dated May 22, 2026 in the matter of IndoStar Credit Fund, addressing regulatory compliance issues related to the fund's operations.

title: SEBI Order in the Matter of Domus Capital LLP
description: SEBI enforcement order against Domus Capital LLP for violations of securities laws, directing specific penalties or remedial actions as determined by the adjudicating authority.

title: SEBI Order in the Matter of India Electronic Development Fund
description: SEBI enforcement order concerning the India Electronic Development Fund (IEDF), an SEBI-registered Alternative Investment Fund focused on the electronics and semiconductor sector.

title: SEBI Order in the Matter of Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar Limited - Fund Diversion and RPT Non-Disclosure
description: SEBI order pursuant to Bombay High Court directions concerning Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar Limited, its promoters Shishir Bajaj and Kushagra Bajaj, involving alleged diversion of over ₹1,189 crore and non-disclosure of related party transactions.

title: SEBI Order Against Future Retail Limited Directors for Fraud, Misleading Disclosures and Fund Diversion
description: SEBI passes a 222-page enforcement order against 11 noticees including Kishore Biyani and other top executives of Future Retail Limited for misleading disclosures, understatement of debt, non-disclosure of related party transactions, and diversion of company funds.

title: SEBI Order on Front Running by Prijesh Kurani and Others
description: SEBI issued an enforcement order against 7 noticees including Prijesh Kurani and associates for front running trades of big client Anustup Trading Private Limited during January 2022 to February 2023.

title: SEBI Order Against Unregistered Investment Advisors Running Telegram Channels Intraday Jackpot and Professional Day Trading Institute
description: SEBI issues enforcement order against Akshay Kumar and five others for operating unregistered investment advisory and research analyst services through Telegram channels, collecting fees and making fraudulent profit claims.

title: Order Against M/s AFCO Capital India Private Limited - Merchant Banker Restrictions
description: SEBI issues order against AFCO Capital India Private Limited (SEBI Reg. No. INM000012555) for violations of Merchant Bankers Regulations, Intermediaries Regulations, PFUTP and PIT Regulations following inspection for April 2022 to August 2024.

title: Order in the matter of Front-running trades of Big Client - Sarvottam Securities Private Limited by multiple entities
description: SEBI order against four individuals — Mr. Sunny Bhatia, Mrs. Surbhi Chopra Bhatia, Mrs. Mamta Rani, and Mr. Kumar Ashok — for front-running trades of Big Client Sarvottam Securities Pvt. Ltd. in equity derivatives during January 2018 to December 2022.

title: SEBI Order Against Retro Green Revolution Limited - Price Manipulation and Market Fraud
description: SEBI issues enforcement order against 21 noticees including promoters and associates of Retro Green Revolution Limited for price manipulation, volume creation, and fraudulent trading activities on BSE.

title: Order Against Cash Cow Broking & Advisory Solutions for Unregistered Investment Advisory Activities
description: SEBI passes directions against Cash Cow Broking & Advisory Solutions and its partners for conducting investment advisory services without registration, ordering refund of fees collected from investors.

title: SEBI Order Against Arcotech Limited: Fund Diversion and Financial Statement Misrepresentation
description: SEBI issues enforcement order against Arcotech Limited and 13 related entities for alleged fund diversion of Rs.14.15 crores, fictitious transactions, and misrepresentation of financial statements across FY 2016-17 to 2020-21.

title: SEBI Order Against Mediaone Global Entertainment Ltd. for Fund Diversion and Financial Manipulation
description: SEBI issues enforcement order against Mediaone Global Entertainment Ltd. and its directors for alleged fund diversion and financial irregularities linked to Eros International Media Limited, involving a write-off of ₹63.61 crore.

title: Order in the matter of trading activities of certain entities in the scrip of DU Digital Technologies Limited (now DU Digital Global Limited)
description: SEBI order against 27 entities for employing deceptive trading strategies and contributing to artificial price and volume manipulation in DU Digital scrip during August 26, 2021 to March 31, 2023.

title: SEBI Final Order against M/s. MAN Industries (India) Limited and Others
description: SEBI final order regarding financial misrepresentation, non-consolidation of subsidiaries, and related party transaction non-disclosures by MAN Industries (India) Limited.

title: Final Order in the matter of Seacoast Shipping Services Limited
description: SEBI issued a final order under sections 11 and 11B of the SEBI Act, 1992 regarding Seacoast Shipping Services Limited and associated noticees concerning misrepresentation of financial statements and other violations.

title: Why our actions needn’t reflect our inner posture—and the question worth asking in pursuit of inner peace
description: A person may hold a demanding office and be at peace with it, while another may give up everything and stay restless. The outward arrangement is irrelevant. The conquest of disquiet can be a futile aim, but the question is whether one is aware of the disquiet, accepts it, and opts to move beyond it.

title: LA for showbiz, NYC for finance: talent clusters still matter in a world shrunk by telecom connectivity
description: Technology may have made geography history, but not the value of talent pools. Places like New York City, Los Angeles and Silicon Valley draw the world’s most talented folks, spurring innovation that spills over to the entire US economy.

title: India will lack ‘viksit’ attributes until its urban agglomerations offer world-class public goods
description: It’s hard to find any member of the Indian establishment who does not have at least one close family member resident in a developed country—they voted with their feet and air tickets. The dismal state of our cities—think of sewerage and rain drainage—frames a big part of India’s challenge.

title: India’s Brics chairship in 2026 offers an opportunity to forge stronger ties that benefit all economies
description: The expanded Brics grouping brings together a vast pool of economic strengths that can be used to build mutual resilience amid supply-chain disruptions and an uncertain environment. India could use its chairship to facilitate collaboration among member countries.

title: Sugar spike: this isn't the first time weak data and ad hoc policies are showing up in food prices
description: Sugarcane as an ethanol input has been on the decline. Blame sugar’s price upshoot on an overestimation of the season’s cane output and ad hoc policies. Untimely tweaks of export and import rules even as El Niño risks loom not only put food security at risk, but are also bad for the economy.

title: Zee case curiosity: Why personal guarantees for loans taken by firms face the arclights again
description: India’s track record of recovering dues based on personal guarantees for corporate loans has been dismal so far. This, along with the eye-popping sums involved, could explain why Subhash Chandra’s case is being watched so keenly.

title: Mint Quick Edit | RBI’s dollar deposit window worked wonders—but let’s be thankful it’s shut now
description: The Reserve Bank of India’s swap scheme for forex deposits has been a dramatic success, going by the huge sum of money attracted. Don’t bemoan its closure ahead of schedule, though. Here’s why

title: India's insolvency framework must adapt to AI: here are some potential grey areas to think about
description: Artificial intelligence (AI) is here and India’s Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC) needs to catch up. The adoption of AI by companies could make cases significantly harder to resolve. Here’s what demands the attention of legislators and regulators.

title: Lesson from Nepal: the world shouldn’t have turned its back on hydro power projects with reservoirs
description: The Narmada case and many others gave big dam projects a bad rap and shifted attention to run-of-river hydro power dams. But the latter can’t help moderate massive water torrents the way large reservoir dams can.

title: Ease of doing business: India should view the World Bank's recrafted survey as a mirror, not a verdict
description: A strong Indian showing in the redesigned survey would be worth more than the World Bank's earlier assessments of how easy it is to do business in India. But what we do with the findings of B-Ready, its new tracker, will matter more than the rank we score.

title: Short-term dollar pressures should not distract India from the need to diversify its forex holdings
description: Even the central banks of US allies are diversifying away from the dollar. Notably, US debt is no longer risk free. In an extreme global crisis, a diversified reserve base would serve India well. And risk mitigation isn’t de-dollarization.

title: Why fewer state-run schools does not signal neglect of education: it’s learning that matters
description: India’s progress on schooling can’t be measured by its school count. Narratives of public education being neglected don't take into account what matters for positive learning outcomes. Here’s what is really going on

title: The next startup revolution is already happening in rural India
description: Bharat’s next generation of founders will not be raised in glass office towers. They will be raised in district headquarters and village markets.

title: Apple's new CEO has a cash pile handy. But the global AI race looks set to test its innovative core
description: Apple Inc’s robust finances and mass-market presence grant its new CEO John Ternus plenty of strategic space to get the company’s act together on AI. Apple’s innovative core, as Steve Jobs shaped it with his call to dent the universe, faces a pivotal test.

title: Mint Quick Edit | India’s investment uptick—an all-engine economic growth run in the making?
description: Last quarter’s gross fixed capital formation data suggests a boom-level 35% of GDP may be within reach. That’s heartening. Now let’s watch for signs of private investment outpacing the fiscal kind. Here’s why it matters.

title: India's pace of economic growth shows that its Viksit Bharat dream is not out of reach
description: Contrary to claims based on miscalculations, India’s economic trajectory needs only a slight pick-up to achieve its target of developed country status by 2047. Here's a look at the Indian economy’s trajectory based on proper calculations.

title: India is an inventive country, yet too many innovations die prematurely. Let’s prevent that
description: It is often suggested that Indians are incapable of coming up with innovative products. That’s not true. The case of India’s Simputer explains why novel ideas don’t get far. An invention is one thing, scaling up for commercial success quite another.

title: Studying the effects of AI is harder when people don’t reveal their usage of it: can AI labs help?
description: People lie about using artificial intelligence (AI), according to new research. The closet use of this technology makes it harder to research. Secretive AI businesses should help researchers work out what’s really going on.

title: Cash is king: why we can’t expect digital payments to dethrone paper money in India
description: Can India completely do away with paper currency now that UPI has attained mass adoption? Not quite. There exist too many use-cases of trail-free paper money that digital payments can’t supplant. Here are five of them.

title: Mergers and acquisitions offer India Inc an opportunity but success hinges on execution in line with a business strategy
description: India Inc’s record shows why companies that pursue inorganic growth must also strengthen innovation, technology, talent and operational excellence. Integration is where value gets created when scaling up rapidly through acquisitions.

title: Warsh's Jackson Hole address outlined key principles for central banks around the world
description: What the US Fed’s new chief had to say at the symposium reassured global markets, while the seven key principles he enunciated for monetary policy are relevant for central banks across the globe—even if his position on communication is contestable.

title: Mint Quick Edit | India GDP growth has surpassed expectations: here’s what to expect
description: The country’s latest GDP data offers a heartening picture of the economy in the last quarter. It’s a story of all-round resilience in the face of global headwinds—and perhaps a scale tilter in the context of RBI policy.
